comparison.objective: Attach a price ticket through a garment care label without piercing the shirt; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift and hold a thin flap while aiming a needle, squeezing a trigger, and withdrawing it versus hex-bit seating, captive-lock manipulation, collar tuning, and test control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Fire once through a label held at least 2 cm clear, never pierce the shirt, withdraw the needle, and release the label. Candidate requires two safe dynamic-stop cycles within force and travel limits.
comparison.reason: Protected thin-flap piercing is unrelated in mechanism and outcome to damper adjustment and dynamic validation.
